Name: Alternate Maru
Author: vampiresstrinity
Description:
I didn't really like the purple hue in Maru's hair and always thought she looked better in the older versions of her images. As such I borrowed part of an older image to give her a new hairstyle that felt more natural on her. I also shrunk her glasses and got rid of those overalls to help her fashion game. Lastly I added saturation so she looked less dull in her portraits. I think the outcome makes her look a lot more mature and less like a 13 year old.

Her sprites will reflect these changes.

[img]http://orig03.deviantart.net/a77d/f/2016/281/8/9/maru_by_lady__amaranth-dakc526.png[/img]

~Installation~
1. Backup Maru.xnb and Maru_Hospital.xnb in Content/Portraits
2. Backup Maru.xnb and Maru_Hospital.xnb in Content/Characters
3. Copy mod version of Maru.xnb and Maru_Hospital.xnb into Content/Portraits
4. Copy mod version of Maru.xnb and Maru_Hospital.xnb into Content/Characters
~Uninstallation~
1. Delete Maru.xnb and Maru_Hospital.xnb in Content/Portraits
2. Delete Maru.xnb and Maru_Hospital.xnb in Content/Characters
2. Replace with backups
